_comment: LlamaFactory dataset registry. Copy this file to dataset_info.json (run_sft.sh will auto-copy on first run) and add an entry for each dataset you want to train on. The 'file_name' may be a path relative to dataset_dir (set in your training YAML) or an absolute path.

my_sharegpt_dataset_example._comment: Standard ShareGPT format: messages with 'from'/'value' keys, optional images list.

my_openai_format_dataset_example._comment: OpenAI-style format: messages with 'role'/'content' keys. Use 'tags' to remap them to ShareGPT roles.
